tools.name: extract
tools.description: Extract content from a web page. Supports HTML and Markdown output formats, optional JavaScript rendering via headless browser, proxy geo-targeting, custom HTTP headers, and explicit browser wait controls via the wait_config object. Can run synchronously (returns content immediately) or asynchronous

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract · Private data: extract · Public sink: extract · Destructive: extract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract · Private data: extract · Public sink: extract · Destructive: extract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
